question: Which of the following options states the different ways of excretion in plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Transpiration, diffusion and storage**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Transpiration, diffusion, and storage** are the different ways of excretion in plants.
 
• **Transpiration** is the process by which water evaporates from the aerial parts of the plant, primarily through the stomata in the leaves.
 
• **Diffusion** involves the movement of substances from an area of higher concentration to an area of lower concentration.
 
• **Storage** refers to the accumulation of waste products in certain parts of the plant, such as leaves, bark, and vacuoles, where they can be isolated from the rest of the plant's cellular activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Plants have evolved various mechanisms to deal with waste products generated during metabolic activities.
 
• **Excretion in plants** is not as complex as in animals because plants produce fewer toxic wastes.
 
• Other methods of excretion in plants include the shedding of leaves, bark, and fruits.
 
• Some plants also excrete waste substances through their roots into the soil.
